DOMAIN (D) — govState is module-private and its only two callers build `{ label: relPath, relPath }` with NO templateKey, on `governance/threat-model.md` and `governance/evaluation-rubric.md`. In src/lib/mission.ts, artifactState returns "untouched" only for a templateKey-ful file byte-identical to its template or for the `adr`/`contracts` directory special cases, so here st ∈ {missing, in-progress, filled} and "untouched" is unreachable. Likewise inProgressCause re-runs the SAME placeholder test that made artifactState say `in-progress` — for a templateKey-less artifact both are `(content.match(PLACEHOLDER)||[]).length >= 3` — so on this path the cause can only ever be "placeholders", and "below-floor" is unreachable. The literal is the second half of a vocabulary govState keeps aligned with `check` (`check.ts` renders the below-floor cause as "started, but too close to the template to count as filled"), kept for the day one of these two governance artifacts gains a `templateKey` and the divergence floor becomes reachable. Measured byte-identical across nine probe missions, including fresh, filled and deleted governance files.
